summary: Clear terms: {{lumen_monthly}}/month (or {{lumen_yearly}}/year), renews automatically, cancel anytime in Settings, effective at the end of the billing period. No partial refunds; prices may change; tax may apply.

clauses.quote: Your subscription auto-renews every month (or every year on the yearly plan).
clauses.plain_english: It renews automatically every month until you cancel.

clauses.quote: Cancel anytime in Settings. Cancelling takes effect at the end of the billing period.
clauses.plain_english: You can cancel yourself at any time; you keep access until the period ends.

clauses.quote: There are no refunds for a partial month or year.
clauses.plain_english: No money back for unused days, which is stated clearly.
